pages.description: Page contents in reading order. Page one is the cover and sits alone on the right.

spread.description: Controlled spread. 0 shows the cover; spread n shows pages 2n and 2n + 1 (one-based).

onSpreadChange.description: Called when a page finishes turning.

tease.description: Curls the cover corner once when the book first comes into view, and a little on hover until the first turn.

hint.description: Hint under the lower outer corner, shown until the first interaction. Pass null to hide it.

controls.description: Shows the page count with previous and next buttons under the book.
